description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6 (P1) — an UPDATE … RETURNING * is a row-producing query: its rows are tagged like a SELECT's and the egress sink strips the protected column. Real Bun.SQL engine; the client cell receives {id, name} only.
rationale: §14.8.9: every compiler-emitted client-egress serializer SHALL strip every column whose provenance origin is a `protect=` field. A RETURNING clause hands back the written rows; before S443 round 6 only SELECT/WITH were tagged and `UPDATE users SET … RETURNING *` served passwordHash over HTTP (measured, reviewer + agent). The RETURNING list is resolved as `SELECT <list> FROM <target>`.
